text: Assumption: Memory areas that are already opened are not closed automatically by the call — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Memory areas that are already opened are not closed automatically by the call — is this correct?
norm: memory areas that are already opened are not closed automatically by the call
assumption: Memory areas that are already opened are not closed automatically by the call.
rationale: SWS_PER_00577 specifies that storages are updated only after closing, but is silent on whether ReloadPersistencyManifest closes open handles.

original.text: Annahme: Bereits geöffnete Speicherbereiche werden durch den Aufruf nicht automatisch geschlossen — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Bereits geöffnete Speicherbereiche werden durch den Aufruf nicht automatisch geschlossen
original.rationale: SWS_PER_00577 spezifiziert, dass Storages erst nach dem Schließen aktualisiert werden, schweigt jedoch dazu, ob ReloadPersistencyManifest geöffnete Handles schließt.
